test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct and meaningful sentence:

(1) The sky turned dark with thick, black clouds.

(2) People rushed to take shelter under nearby shops and trees.

(3) A loud clap of thunder followed by heavy rainfall startled everyone.

(4) The wind began to blow strongly, scattering leaves and dust.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph describes a sequence of events occurring during a storm.
 
• **Sentence 1 is the first sentence** as it sets the initial scene:
 
 
• "The sky turned dark with thick, black clouds."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 follows** as it describes the next stage of the storm:
 
 
• "The wind began to blow strongly, scattering leaves and dust."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 is the third sentence** because it describes the thunder and rain:
 
 
• "A loud clap of thunder followed by heavy rainfall startled everyone."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2 is the fourth** as it describes people’s reaction to the storm:
 
 
• "People rushed to take shelter under nearby shops and trees."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **1-4-3-2**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The sky turned dark with thick, black clouds. The wind began to blow strongly, scattering leaves and dust. A loud clap of thunder followed by heavy rainfall startled everyone. People rushed to take shelter under nearby shops and trees."
